name: codex-desk-buddy
description: Send privacy-bounded Codex lifecycle state to a local Codex Desk Buddy bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Sync Codex lifecycle state to your desk companion.
interface.longDescription: Forwards bounded lifecycle metadata to a token-authenticated local bridge and relays explicit device decisions for permission requests. It never reads transcripts or tool results.
defaultPrompt: Show the current Codex Desk Buddy connection status.
